WITH overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(GOT) AS overall_avg_got
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT l.ID,
       AVG(l.GOT) AS average_got,
       AVG(l.RBC) AS average_rbc,
       AVG(l.GOT) - overall.overall_avg_got AS got_difference
FROM Laboratory AS l
CROSS JOIN overall
GROUP BY l.ID
HAVING overall.overall_avg_got IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY got_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
